eyelink1000plus._note_area_scale: [x_scale, y_scale] multipliers applied to pyelink's default area proportion (0.88, 0.83). Final calibration_area_proportion = [x_scale * 0.88, y_scale * 0.83]. Two values so horizontal and vertical can be pulled in independently (e.g. [0.75, 0.85] tightens x more than y).
